# Qratum — full

> Qratum is a local-first library, vault, and refinery for AI coding sessions. It captures, preserves, normalizes, redacts, reviews, and verifies your Claude Code sessions — without ever uploading your raw transcripts. Single Go binary (`qrt`), v0.1.0, install with `brew install qratum`. No cloud, no accounts, no telemetry.

Website: https://qratum.dev
Repository: https://github.com/edictum-ai/qratum
License: MIT

## What it is
Qratum is the local librarian for AI session data — the system of record for where session data came from: raw history, provenance, and deterministic derivations. The first user is the developer running it on their own machine.

## Why it exists
AI coding tools delete sessions. Claude Code purges transcripts after ~30 days; months of debugging, decisions, and trajectories vanish, and nothing records provenance. Qratum fixes both: it preserves, and it remembers where the data came from.

## The three pillars

### The Vault
Content-addressed capture and archive. A transcript the tool deletes tomorrow is recoverable.
- Copy-on-capture: every session end writes a blob plus a ref.
- Dedup by sha256 digest — backfill is a no-op the second time.
- Backups that prove themselves: `qrt vault backup --verify`.
- Survives abandonment gracefully — passive value from day one.

### The Refinery
On-demand pipeline: normalize → deterministic redaction → evidence extraction → review → report → corpus export. Runs only when you ask.
- Deterministic redaction as the first safety boundary.
- Evidence signals: edits-after-verify, no final test, retry loops, file thrashing.
- No daemon, no queue, no automatic review.
- ADP and native corpus JSONL export, eligibility-checked.

### Provenance
The system of record for where session data came from.
- Every object carries schema_version, producer, and transform version.
- Data-class lineage: raw → redacted → review → corpus → published.
- Content-addressed blobs are immutable; refs are the pointers.
- Tombstones, never silent deletion.

## Trust & safety (local-first by architecture)
- Raw transcripts stay on your machine unless explicitly approved. No cloud by default.
- No boundary may silently upgrade to a more sensitive data class. Raw → external or published always requires explicit consent.
- Deterministic redaction is the first downgrade boundary; redaction uncertainty blocks export.
- No raw transcript routes in the app shell. No raw content in logs, spans, or metrics — paths and digests only.

## Status (honest)
v0.1.0 — first release. Shipped: the vault (global Claude Code capture, content-addressed raw archive, sha256 dedup, `vault doctor`, `backup --verify`, `vault gc`, tombstone-based `vault erase`, `vault install-schedule`); the on-demand refinery (normalize → deterministic redaction → evidence → review → report → ADP strict JSONL export); and the verification trust gate (`qrt trust` / `make trust` drives the real CLI against planted-secret and reflection-canary corpora and emits a qratum.trust_scorecard.v1 verdict — TRUSTED / TRUSTED-WITH-NAMED-GAPS / NOT-TRUSTED — with an honest-residual block). Every emitted object carries a data_class and is schema-validated. Capture and refine are Claude-Code-only; non-Claude/vendor blobs are archive-only with no redaction path. Redaction is credentials-only and best-effort alpha — PII and third-party content are preserved verbatim; the trust gate names the residual classes that can still leak.

## Roadmap
- Milestone A — vertical slice (done).
- P0 — spec & contracts (done).
- P1 — the vault (done).
- P2 — verification trust gate (done): `qrt trust` scorecard, reflection-canary redaction proofs, vault gc/erase/install-schedule, data_class lineage, schema conformance.
- v0.1.0 — first release (now): `brew install qratum`, single Go binary, darwin + linux.
- Next — cross-repo curation: consumer-side memory-import receipts, gated on the personal-memory gateway producer.
- Later — hardening: PII/third-party detection, audit-log tamper-evidence, multi-machine merge (named, deferred future work).

## Quick start
```
brew tap edictum-ai/edictum
brew trust edictum-ai/edictum
brew install qratum
qrt hook install
qrt daemon run-once
qrt sessions list
qrt trust
```

## Ecosystem
- Qratum — the librarian: vault + refinery for AI session data.
- Edictum — runtime process enforcement for AI agents.
- Ductum — coming soon: the AI Software Factory.
